result.title: Where Should a Diffusion Transformer Meet Its Teacher?
result.summary: Representation Alignment (REPA) significantly accelerates Diffusion Transformer training by guiding intermediate student features with a pretrained visual teacher, yet existing methods typically attach supervision to a single fixed layer. As student representations evolve, however, we find that the most effective layer for alignment varies across training stages. To track this evolving layer suitability online without costly search, we measure gradient compatibility between the flow-matching and alignment objectives, and propose AdaREPA, an online routing framework that adaptively selects the supervision layer as training progresses. AdaREPA uses a softmax distribution over smoothed layer compatibility scores to sample a layer for alignment at each training step. This probabilistic routing adapts teacher supervision to the student's changing learning needs, with minimal training overhead and no additional inference cost. On ImageNet-256, AdaREPA accelerates convergence and improves generation quality across model sizes, while revealing how the most suitable layers for supervision shift over training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散 Transformer 的表示对齐应接在哪一层，发现最有效的对齐层会随训练阶段变化，于是提出 AdaREPA，用流匹配目标与对齐目标的梯度兼容性对平滑后的各层得分做 softmax 采样，在线选择监督层。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“监督层位置随训练动态变化、按梯度兼容性路由”的做法，可能为 LVR 训练中 latent 监督应加在何处、如何分配监督贡献提供可核查线索，也呼应表征相似度对深度与位置的敏感性；但任务属图像生成，迁移性待评估。
